rows.text: Under the gentle caress of the Chrysalis of Gold, even the stoniest of hearts can grasp the essence of love. Butterflies etched melodies onto the stone disc as a testament to the beauty and art of the world — from majestic choral performances and solitary bardic verses to the distant calls of birds from the wilderness. In the praise song of the devout, the Contemplation Disc meticulously recreates every note, making it an elegant tool for showcasing personal taste at social gatherings in Okhema. However, remember not to switch someone else's music casually, as this could provoke the wrath of Mnestia.
